captions.text: Everything on your website starts here.
The WBSK Studio. A short film, starring you.
Every morning starts here.
Waiting for you: drafts, and reviews to approve.
Worth a look: small fixes. No panic.
Lost? Press ⌘K anywhere. (Windows: Ctrl + K.)
Type a couple’s name…
…or a job. Press return, and you’re there.
Add a wedding. Names, six photos, a gallery and films.
A new wedding opens as five steps.
Type their names. The preview types along.
The page address writes itself.
Six photos. Each has its own shape.
Album cover: tall and narrow, 3:7.
Bride and groom pages: a matching pair, 4:5.
Card, for the Weddings page: 4:5 again.
Too small? The Studio refuses it, politely.
Desktop cover, 21:9. Phone cover, 3:4.
The gallery: drop 50 or 60 at once. Drag to reorder.
Every photo needs a description. Yes, every one.
Allow 10 to 15 minutes. Publishing waits for them.
A short line for the card, and their story.
Films are YouTube links, each with a 16:9 poster.
One switch puts their album on the homepage.
On the homepage, albums drift along a dark table.
Press one, and it opens to the bride and groom.
Bride on the left. Groom on the right. Their names below.
Step by step. A bar that says where you are, and what’s left.
It always says where you are: Step 2 of 5.
Next and Back move you along. The line fills up.
Finished steps get a tick at the top.
The ring fills up. Each chip names what’s left.
Press a chip, and it takes you to the place.
Nothing left? Ready to publish.
How this works. Short steps, in a drawer, whenever you need them.
Not sure how something works?
Short steps for this kind of entry, beside your work.
A film has its own. So does a review, or a shoot.
Saved and published. It saves itself. Nothing goes live until you say.
See this pill? Every change saves itself.
Nothing goes live until you press Publish.
Published. On the website in about 10 minutes.
When it’s ready, View on website takes you there.
Then look at it on your phone. Always.
Films, pre-wedding and more. The other things you’ll look after.
Films: a YouTube link, a poster, two switches.
Featured: the homepage. Show on Films page: the Films page.
Pre-wedding: add a destination, then its shoots.
Its record appears once it has a published shoot.
Reviews: ask the couple first, then switch on Approved.
Team: a black and white 4:5 portrait.
Open roles: on Careers, and in its form.
Featured on: who has written about you.
The chat enquiry. One question at a time, in your words.
On the website, couples answer one question at a time.
Their answers reach you as usual.
In the Studio, Enquiry forms lets you reword them.
How the chat asks it changes the question…
…What the chat says back changes its reply.
Switch a question off, and the chat skips it.
Quotes. A rough estimate, from your own prices.
A new item in the top menu: Quotes.
First, your prices. These are made up.
Saved privately: only people signed in can see them.
Then fill in what the couple told the chat.
Up comes the estimate range, and how it was worked out.
And a message, for you to read and change.
Copy it, or open it in WhatsApp or email.
Nothing about a couple is saved here.
Good to know. Photo sizes, taking things down, the status light.
Photos start in Lightroom. Nine presets size them for you.
Three ways to take something down. Nothing is lost.
Archive: older work. Off the lists and the homepage. Its own page still works for old links.
Remove from website: when a couple asks. Gone everywhere. Its address leads back to the Weddings page.
Hide from website: films, reviews, team, roles. Not shown anywhere, until you switch it back.
Never delete.
Deleting for good is for the owner only.
This light says when your change is live.
While it updates: gold, and Home’s record spins faster.
If it turns red, your work is safe. Press Try again.
Stuck?
Open the Guide: every step, written down. Or press ⌘K and search for anything.
Now go and add a wedding.
